name: Swing and Miss
source:
You have taken some time off work to travel a bit.  It's been a rough trip with multiple long bus rides, but don't worry. You've only got one more bus left. After that, you can finally relax. 

[from [url=https://sudachys.itch.io/swing-and-miss]itch.io[/url]]
